create_adsorbate_from_atoms: create an Adsorbate object from an ase.Atoms structure with specified binding atom indices
create_adsorbate_from_db_id: create an Adsorbate object by loading a specific adsorbate from the database using its integer ID
create_adsorbate_from_smiles: create an Adsorbate object by looking up a SMILES string in the adsorbate database
sample_random_adsorbate: sample a random Adsorbate from the adsorbate database when no specific selection criteria are provided
rotate_adsorbate_randomly: apply random or heuristic 3D rotation to an adsorbate around its center of mass or binding atom
